# UX & Access-State Requirements Checklist: Create Spec Button

**Purpose**: Validate quality of UI placement, state, permission, and prefill requirements before implementation (PR reviewer, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for the interim "checking availability/permission" state that the UI contract introduces? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Contract]
- [ ] CHK002 Is behavior specified when both "unavailable" and "forbidden" conditions apply at once? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the sources of prefilled values beyond the component (system, domain, owner) reflected in the spec rather than only the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the case where a component's identity cannot be resolved for prefill? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the required behavior defined if availability/permission lookups themselves fail or time out? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "upper right area of the page" defined with measurable positioning (e.g., header action slot, alignment)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "visible explanation" specified (location relative to button, wording, persistence)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "workflow is unavailable" defined with objective criteria (e.g., not registered vs. not reachable)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "start of the workflow" defined precisely enough to distinguish it from other workflow steps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "pre-selected where the workflow asks for a component" clear about what happens if the workflow has no component field? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec's "disabled with visible explanation" requirements align with the contract's wording and states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006/007, Contract]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the P3 priority of pre-association consistent with its description as "required" behavior (FR-005 uses MUST)? [Conflict, Spec §US2, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "disabled while checking" contract state consistent with FR-008's "enabled when available and permitted"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Contract]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the "no broken or empty page" and "existing access rules unchanged" requirements consistent with each other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001 (100% of pages) be objectively measured given components without a specs page are excluded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-002's "single click" account for the disabled and checking states? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Are acceptance criteria defined for the pre-selection and editability of the component? [Gap, Spec §US2]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the narrow-screen layout beyond "visible and reachable" (breakpoints, wrapping with explanation text)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery requirements defined for when availability or permission changes after page load? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements specified for component names/refs needing special encoding in prefill data? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the behavior defined for unauthenticated or guest users on the specs page? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are accessibility requirements (keyboard focus, disabled-state semantics, explanation association) stated in the spec rather than only the contract? [Gap, Contract]
- [ ] CHK025 Are visual consistency requirements with existing catalog page action buttons specified? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that the workflow template exists validated for environments where it is not registered (e.g., local)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the dependency on the external template repository and its identifier documented as a requirement-level dependency? [Dependency, Contract]
- [ ] CHK028 Is "existing access rules" identified specifically enough to determine which permission governs the button? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
